package main import ( "strings" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui" ) // Card is a titled box: its fields are its props, its markup below. type Card struct { Title string Tags []string Children ui.Node } // Heading is the title as the card shows it. func (c Card) Heading() string { return strings.ToUpper(c.Title) }

{Heading()}

for _, t := range Tags { {t} } {c.Children}
